title: Why is Apple asking me to pay more for Big Tech’s AI obsession?
brief: Apple raised prices on MacBook Pro ($300 increase), iPad Air ($150 increase), and HomePod Mini ($30 increase), with CEO Tim Cook attributing the hikes to "unavoidable" costs driven by the AI industry's demands. The move follows similar price increases across Big Tech, including Xbox consoles and gaming hardware, as manufacturers cite rising component costs tied to AI infrastructure.
